verdict.rationale: MailerLite documents campaign reports and link-click retrieval, click maps showing where subscribers click, and custom reports that analyze campaigns by audience or timeframe. That covers per-campaign click analytics over time. Missing for 10: per-automation-step reporting, explicit open/unsubscribe/conversion metrics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can read opens, clicks, unsubscribes, and conversions per campaign and per automation step, over time

citations.quote: retrieve campaign reports and link clicks
See where subscribers click inside your emails.
Build custom reports with grouping and filtering to analyze campaigns by audience or timeframe.
